selection: Fixed existing small Scholten test grid; every listed cell retained. No outcome-based seed search or extension.
fault_rule: For EACH fixed case whose retained actual callback contains identity or duplicate, rerun the same case once per matching kind and Write/Flush fault. Do not select seeds or change inputs.
outputs_and_arithmetic_comparison: Compare entire serialized Outcome including recovered/exhausted/phases/counts/native/detail; independently check source kG=Q. Compare entire actual Labels result including scalar_before/after and field delta.
failure_rules: Constructor None, identity source target, missing source solve, mismatch, missing required branch or missing terminal is a failed/incomplete qualification, not a skipped cell.
Record missing branches and stop after fixed panel; no supplemental seed screening.
Fault must occur inside actual callback and result in Err, incomplete trace, no terminal or successful Outcome.
Retain compile errors, timeouts, partial stdout/stderr and every attempted case.
cache_binding: Root must reconcile mutable build cache and bind full current manifest before admitted build; do not reuse an unbound initial cache.
counted_cost_policy: All qualification, compilation, fixture construction, fault runs and cleanup charged; no timing/rho ratio inferred.
